items.claim: Gillian Robertson is a decent striker with forward pressure and a decent one-two.
items.quote: Decent striker. Neither of these two are good at all in the striking, but like there are some positives. And the forward pressure and she's got a decent one-two for Robertson is there.

items.claim: Gillian Robertson is durable and can take a punch.
items.quote: She's durable as well. She can take a punch

items.claim: Gillian Robertson is the better wrestler at getting takedowns and is persistent in getting them.
items.quote: She's the um probably the better at getting the takedowns. She's a solid grappler overall, but she has a decent takedown and she is persistent in getting the takedown

items.claim: Gillian Robertson constantly attacks with armbars and rear-naked chokes, chaining them together with slick mat transitions.
items.quote: She does constantly attack with the armbars and the rear naked chokes. She'll chain them together... She's got slick transitions on the mat

items.claim: Gillian Robertson is very willing to use heavy ground and pound to open up submission attempts.
items.quote: she is very willing to go with the heavy heavy ground and pound to open up the submission attempts.

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern's striking is inconsistent and lacks development consistency.
items.quote: It's not good by any means. In fact, sometimes she'll show improvement, but it's not consistent.

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern has a decent step-in overhand that works for her despite being strange.
items.quote: She does have a decent step-in overhand... It's very strange, but it works, right? It works for her.

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern's striking defense is not good at all.
items.quote: striking defense isn't good at all. Not at all.

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern is very tough and durable.
items.quote: her durability is there. She's tough. You're never going to see Mackenzie Dern just kind of like wilt.

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern has solid grappling with good transitions, control, and an in-depth submission arsenal, but lacks open-mat takedowns.
items.quote: As far as grappling goes, she's solid there, too. She's got good transitions, very good control. She advances position extremely well. She's got a very in-depth submission arsenal, but she does lack open-mat takedowns.

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern was able to control Virna Jandiroba on the mat in two separate fights.
items.quote: And we saw that with with Virna Jandiroba, how she was able to like control an extremely high-level grappler... And Mackenzie's done it twice

items.claim: Ian Garry is a solid striker with high accuracy and good combinations.
items.quote: solid striker. I would say that he's probably one of the more accurate guys in the division. He's got He's got good combinations and he puts them right where he wants them.

items.claim: Ian Garry backs up with his chin down, though it hasn't cost him due to his durability and fast recovery.
items.quote: he'll back up with his chin down. It hasn't cost him though because he's durable and he recovers extremely fast.

items.claim: Ian Garry is a solid grappler with good cage control, back takes, and great takedown defense.
items.quote: He's a solid grappler, too. He's got a good cage push... He's got a good back takes. Once he gets there, he's got very good control and he's got great takedown defense.

items.claim: Islam Makhachev has high striking defense aided by his range control and feints that force opponent inactivity.
items.quote: he doesn't get enough credit for his striking because I think a lot of it comes defensively and what he forces out of his opponent... because he's controlling the range, he's controlling the activity, and people just aren't hitting him.

items.claim: Islam Makhachev is an excellent grappler with near-perfect takedown entries, often transitioning from single legs to inside trips.
items.quote: He is an excellent grappler, in fact, I think he's the best grappler in the UFC. He's got near perfect takedown entries... he'll go in for like a single leg, and then he'll switch it to the inside trip
